Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Double DJ mentioned in a post that when he started playing, he bought a couple of starters at a friend's new store. Also, the deck mash-up challenge has always put forth that buying two pre-con decks and mashing them together is a good way to get started as a new player.

I bought a Toreador  (Camarilla edition) starter and a Toreador Antitribu  (black hand) starter. My first deck was a terrible toolbox Tore Anti  deck that was the classic newbie "stay alive but never oust" type deck. For a second deck, I traded some of the vamps from the Toreador  (CE) deck for more type 1-2 vamps and was given a Mariana Gilbert By Mike Courtois to round it out. It is an old school Toreador  deck which I still love to play (even though I haven't played it much lately).

So, what were /was your first starter deck/s?

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Camarilla Edition Toreador.  Oh joy, those were the days... I had misplaced all my blood dolls and other good cards for half-a-year, and wondered why I never won any games. Also I was obsessed with getting Alexandra up every time I could, so you can guess the outcome - and taste my frustration.

Afterwards I bought a Toreador Antitribu starter from Black Hand, and played that for a longer while (since I didn't think my princes could really do anything), and always thought that G2-3 sabbat vampires have vastly superior Discipline variety to the Camarilla guys.

I still remember how badly we all lost to my mate's Tremere...  There was 'nothing we could do about it'.

Eventually I got G1 Torries from a friend who had bought the 10th anniversary boxes, and decided to give another go with the Princes. Never strayed from that path, to be honest. And drawing an Aching Beauty from a random booster I bought (but can't remember doing that.  I had Ritual of the Bitter Rose at that time, and remember trading that off for stuff, even though I really liked the card. Was a hard time, it seems...  ), and that was in the very beginning, it seems, I really had a chance sometimes. People really hated Aching Beauty.

But yeah, Camarilla Toreador Starter all the way. It was wonderful.

Messages.Author: vragozakas
Messages.Body: I begun the game in 1999-2000, with some vtes cards a friend gave me. I made 2 decks from that. A tremere toolbox with the amazing ulug and some governs-sawed off shotgun....and a malk s&b. Then came the day I played my first game, sold the tremere deck to a friend, and won a 3 players table with the malk. Incidentally I fell in love for ventrue, and the "knight" concept (bleed, if you block I play dawn operation + punch for 1, defense second trad + deflection). So had to buy the closest thing to that concept. At that time ventrue antitribu was in stores, and lazverinus was my god. This must be the why and how I bought my first starter.
